summary: Repair audit of the whole PRD after Phases 3 and 4 (20 criteria, four rounds): 5 criteria are still not fully built. Several more screens, messages and terminal lines show Kiln's internal name instead of a repository's label: early merges, the catch-up offer, audit facts, Folder missing text, Documents found messages and setup errors. A take-over or hand-back stop doesn't ask a session's repository question until Check again. A link beside the PRD's repository can reach a recorded checkout. One Start can give two repositories the same worktree folder when a folder name contains '+'. The kiln status locate lines lack the drawn colours. Phase 5 builds them. The fourth round still found a new gap.
